name: nexuskit
description: NexusKit：24 个 nk-* 技能，按需组合，覆盖需求澄清、实施、审查与交付；nk-odyssey 为测试中技能。

interface.shortDescription: 轻量工程技能：澄清需求、组织实现与交付
interface.longDescription: NexusKit provides 24 nk-* skills: nk-ask-ljq, nk-codecraft, nk-commit, nk-debug, nk-domain-modeling, nk-grill, nk-implement, nk-init, nk-odyssey, nk-orca-guide, nk-pr, nk-prose, nk-prototype, nk-research, nk-retro, nk-review, nk-spec-close, nk-tdd, nk-to-issue, nk-to-spec, nk-to-tickets, nk-wait-what, nk-wayfinder, nk-wizard. nk-odyssey is experimental; its multi-agent orchestration still needs end-to-end validation in real tasks.
